answer: By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. The dawn is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the signal. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
